title: OpenAI’s new economic analysis
summary: Analysis provides insights into ChatGPT’s impact on the economy. OpenAI also launches new research collaboration to study AI’s broader effects on the labor market and productivity.
body: Analysis provides insights into ChatGPT’s impact on the economy. OpenAI also launches new research collaboration to study AI’s broader effects on the labor market and productivity.
summaryZh: OpenAI 发布了关于 ChatGPT 对经济影响的最新分析报告，深入探讨了 AI 技术在提升生产力方面的作用。同时，OpenAI 启动了一项新的研究合作计划，旨在系统性地评估 AI 对劳动力市场及宏观经济的长期影响。该报告为政策制定者和企业提供了关于 AI 经济价值的量化视角，是理解当前 AI 产业化进程及其社会经济后果的重要参考资料。
